plants.original: At least 25 seafarers have been killed in and around the Strait of Hormuz since the US-Israeli war on Iran began in February, UN official Khaled Khiari told the Security Council on Friday. Iranian authorities said on Saturday that three oil tankers hit mines in "unauthorised" or "restricted" areas of the strait and caught fire. Iran's Revolutionary Guards earlier said two tankers hit mines. The US military says it has cleared the main routes and the strait is open, but UKMTO puts traffic about 65 percent below pre-war levels.
